info.title: FastHook Control API — Partial contract
info.description: A deliberately partial contract for stable FastHook Control API surfaces. It does not claim coverage of the complete Control API.

excluded: All Control API resources other than project-api-keys, stored Filter CRUD/test, stored Transformation CRUD/execution-history plus stateless validate/run and capabilities endpoints, Workflow CRUD/run-history/manual Step retry, Action CRUD/status and dynamic options, Connection CRUD/status/pause/latest-input, Source CRUD/status, Destination CRUD/status, Provider Account operations, provider catalogs, resource metrics, and Request reads
Request share/retry mutations; Event and Attempt collection/detail; Source channel operations; delivery activity; and manual execution/retry endpoints
The legacy /v1/destinations/metrics alias and legacy POST enable/disable aliases, whose legacy response DTO differs from the canonical Destination projection
Legacy google-oauth Provider Account aliases, direct-handler-test-only OAuth paths, OAuth state/credential storage internals, and provider subscription/channel cleanup internals
CLI commands and widget runtime surfaces; synchronized artifacts do not imply owner-session feature support
The hand-authored public documentation OpenAPI document
